title: Group named fields
summary: PL/SQL: Group named fields. Print the title instead.
introduction: A record groups related values into one local data item. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.

blocks.title: Group named fields

blocks.text: The local record receives a title and page count. Reading book.pages gives 24.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Set a field before assuming it has a useful value.
